newsitem.title: UK: EBRD sees Russia as "the growth story for 1997".
newsitem.headline: EBRD sees Russia as "the growth story for 1997".

text.p: Russia is the growth story for 1997, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) first vice president Ronald Freeman told a conference on Saturday.
"Economists will find that Russia is the growth story for 1997," Freeman said.
"We believe that Russia will continue to drive strongly towards increases in its economic growth rate and receptivity to the foreign investment necessary to drive this growth forward," he said.

Freeman said recent government changes confirmed this view and added that Anatoly Chubais and Boris Nemstov, recently appointed first deputy prime ministers were "both unequivocally reform minded and effective executives."
He said that Russia's central bank chairman Sergei Dubinin exercised "strong and steady control on the rouble."
